# Cops

<!-- Generated by `UPDATE_DOCS=1 bin/test`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every cop lives under the `Callbacksystems/` namespace and is on by default.
Each one links to its source, where the header comment explains what it is for
and why, and an `@example` block contrasts bad and good code.

Options and the paths a cop applies to are in
[`config/default.yml`](../config/default.yml).

| Cop | Fix | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`ApplicationControllerMethodDefinition`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/application_controller_method_definition.rb) |  | Prohibits defining methods directly in ApplicationController. |
| [`AssertWithExpectedArgument`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/assert_with_expected_argument.rb) |  | `assert expected, actual` passes whenever `expected` is truthy, so a two-argument `assert` usually means `assert_equal`. |
| [`BuilderMethodParentheses`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/builder_method_parentheses.rb) | yes | Requires parentheses on builder method calls (`.new`, ActiveRecord persistence, finders, strong parameters) when they have arguments. |
| [`CollapseMultilineExpression`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/collapse_multiline_expression.rb) | yes | Detects multiline expressions that can fit on a single line and collapses them. |
| [`ComplexConditional`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/complex_conditional.rb) |  | Detects complex conditionals with too many boolean operators. |
| [`ControllerTestResponseAssertion`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/controller_test_response_assertion.rb) |  | In controller tests, every test that makes an HTTP request must assert the response. |
| [`ControllerTestResponseFirstAssertion`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/controller_test_response_first_assertion.rb) |  | In controller tests, the first assertion after an HTTP request must be a response assertion (assert_response or assert_redirected_to). |
| [`DataClump`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/data_clump.rb) |  | Detects a set of parameter names that travel together across a class's or module's private methods. |
| [`DeclarativeMethodNaming`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/declarative_method_naming.rb) |  | A method that returns a value should be named for the value it hands back, not for the imperative action it performs. |
| [`DelegateModuleFunctions`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/delegate_module_functions.rb) | yes | Detects methods that only wrap the same-named method on a constant. |
| [`DelegateRequiresPrivateOption`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/delegate_requires_private_option.rb) | yes | `delegate` does not inherit the visibility of the surrounding section. |
| [`EagerLoadingScopeNaming`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/eager_loading_scope_naming.rb) |  | Ensures eager loading scopes follow naming conventions. |
| [`EarlyReturn`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/early_return.rb) |  | Prohibits early exits except for a single guard clause on the first line. |
| [`EmptyLineBeforeMethod`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/empty_line_before_method.rb) | yes | Enforces an empty line before method definitions. |
| [`EmptyPrivateSection`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/empty_private_section.rb) | yes | A `private` keyword with nothing after it declares a section that holds nothing. |
| [`ExpandedEmptyClassOrModule`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/expanded_empty_class_or_module.rb) | yes | An empty class or module keeps its `end` on a line of its own, the way `Style/EmptyMethod` already asks of an empty method. |
| [`InlineMemoizedComputation`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/inline_memoized_computation.rb) |  | Detects memoization methods that delegate to another method in the same class. |
| [`JobEnqueueMethods`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/job_enqueue_methods.rb) |  | Ensures methods that enqueue jobs follow the `_later` naming convention. |
| [`MaxSafeNavigationDepth`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/max_safe_navigation_depth.rb) |  | Deeply chained safe navigation (`a&.b&.c&.d&.e`) signals deep coupling or poor data modelling. |
| [`MethodInvocationOrder`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/method_invocation_order.rb) | yes | Ensures methods are ordered by invocation: callers before callees, and a caller's callees in the order it first invokes them (depth-first). |
| [`MixinsFirst`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/mixins_first.rb) | yes | Mixins come before anything else in a class or module body, constants included. |
| [`NestedClassesAtEndOfPrivateSection`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/nested_classes_at_end_of_private_section.rb) |  | Ensures private nested classes are defined at the end of the private section. |
| [`NoAbbreviations`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_abbreviations.rb) |  | Prohibits common abbreviations in method, variable, and constant names. |
| [`NoAnemicDelegation`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_anemic_delegation.rb) |  | Detects private methods that only delegate to a newly created object. |
| [`NoAnemicRecord`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_anemic_record.rb) |  | A hash of three or more keys, built in one place and read from several others, is a data clump wearing braces. |
| [`NoAssertSelect`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_assert_select.rb) |  | Prohibits using assert_select in tests. |
| [`NoBangMethodWithoutCounterpart`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_bang_method_without_counterpart.rb) |  | Prohibits bang methods (ending with `!`) unless a non-bang counterpart exists. |
| [`NoCallMethod`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_call_method.rb) |  | Prohibits defining methods named `call`. |
| [`NoCommentsInTestClassBody`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_comments_in_test_class_body.rb) | yes | Detects comments in the direct body of test classes. |
| [`NoCustomRouteActions`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_custom_route_actions.rb) |  | Keeps routes on the standard resource actions, so a custom action becomes its own resource instead of a member or collection addition. |
| [`NoDirectEagerLoading`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_direct_eager_loading.rb) |  | Prohibits using preload, eager_load, or includes directly in controllers. |
| [`NoEachWithEarlyReturn`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_each_with_early_return.rb) |  | Detects each blocks with conditional early returns that should use find. |
| [`NoExplicitPublicModifier`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_explicit_public_modifier.rb) | yes | Do not use explicit `public` modifier. |
| [`NoHashWithDefaultBlock`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_hash_with_default_block.rb) |  | Detects `Hash.new` with a default block that initializes missing keys to an empty collection. |
| [`NoLocalVariableReturn`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_local_variable_return.rb) | yes | Prohibits returning a local variable as the last statement of a method. |
| [`NoManualAccumulation`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_manual_accumulation.rb) |  | Detects manual accumulation patterns that should use declarative methods. |
| [`NoMixedMemoization`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_mixed_memoization.rb) |  | Detects memoization mixed with other statements in the same method. |
| [`NoNestedModulesInClasses`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_nested_modules_in_classes.rb) |  | Forbids nested modules inside classes. |
| [`NoNilAtEndOfMethod`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_nil_at_end_of_method.rb) | yes | Prohibits returning nil at the end of a method. |
| [`NoRedundantWrapperMethod`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_redundant_wrapper_method.rb) |  | Detects private methods that only call another method without adding value. |
| [`NoSectionDividerComments`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_section_divider_comments.rb) | yes | ASCII-art section dividers in comments add no information. |
| [`NoSendInTests`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_send_in_tests.rb) |  | Prohibits using `send` or `__send__` inside test blocks. |
| [`NoServiceObjects`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_service_objects.rb) |  | Prohibits files in service object-style directories under `app/`. |
| [`NoSingleLetterNames`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_single_letter_names.rb) |  | Detects single-letter names for variables, block arguments, and method parameters. |
| [`NoSingletonClassInModules`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_singleton_class_in_modules.rb) |  | Forbids using `class << self` inside modules. |
| [`NoTapCollectionBuilding`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_tap_collection_building.rb) |  | Detects using tap to build collections imperatively. |
| [`NoTypographicClutter`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_typographic_clutter.rb) | yes | Keeps typographic characters out of source: smart quotes, en/em dashes, ellipses, arrows, bullets, zero-width spaces. |
| [`NoWritesInGetActions`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/no_writes_in_get_actions.rb) |  | Keeps GET actions free of writes and enqueued side effects. |
| [`OrderedMixinArguments`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/ordered_mixin_arguments.rb) | yes | Ensures the modules of one mixin call are sorted alphabetically. |
| [`PluralControllerNames`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/plural_controller_names.rb) |  | Ensures controller names are plural. |
| [`PreferAttrReaderOverInstanceVariable`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_attr_reader_over_instance_variable.rb) |  | Detects direct use of instance variables that were assigned in initialize. |
| [`PreferBackslashContinuation`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_backslash_continuation.rb) | yes | Prefers backslash line continuation over parentheses for multiline method calls. |
| [`PreferClassForState`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_class_for_state.rb) |  | Detects a single value threaded through many method calls. |
| [`PreferClassNewForEmptyNestedClass`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_class_new_for_empty_nested_class.rb) | yes | A nested class with no body declares that something exists, most often an error. |
| [`PreferClassOverBuilderBlock`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_class_over_builder_block.rb) | yes | A `Data.define`, `Struct.new` or `Class.new` given a block defines a class with behavior, so it reads better as the class it is. |
| [`PreferDeclarativeCollections`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_declarative_collections.rb) |  | Detects imperative collection building that could be written declaratively. |
| [`PreferDelegate`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_delegate.rb) | yes | Detects methods that only delegate to a same-named method on a plain receiver (`def size; node.size; end`). |
| [`PreferDelegateOverIvarAssignment`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_delegate_over_ivar_assignment.rb) |  | Detects `@x = receiver.x` style assignments inside `initialize` that mirror a method call. |
| [`PreferExcluding`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_excluding.rb) | yes | Detects `array - [element]` patterns that should use `excluding`. |
| [`PreferItBlockParameter`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_it_block_parameter.rb) | yes | Detects single-line brace blocks with a single parameter that should use `it` instead. |
| [`PreferMany`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_many.rb) | yes | Detects `collection.size > 1` patterns that should use `many?`. |
| [`PreferMethodOverVariable`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_method_over_variable.rb) |  | Detects local variable assignments that could be methods instead. |
| [`PreferModuleForStaticClass`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_module_for_static_class.rb) |  | A class whose whole body is class-level code should be a module with `extend self`. |
| [`PreferOrdinalArrayAccess`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_ordinal_array_access.rb) | yes | Detects array access with numeric indices that could use ordinal methods. |
| [`PreferPositiveWrap`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_positive_wrap.rb) | yes | A negative `return unless` guard followed by a happy path reads more naturally as `if cond; ...; end`. |
| [`PreferSquish`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_squish.rb) | yes | Detects `str.strip.gsub(/\s+/, " ")` patterns that should use `squish`. |
| [`PreferStringifyKeys`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_stringify_keys.rb) | yes | Detects `hash.transform_keys(&:to_s)` patterns that should use `stringify_keys`. |
| [`PreferSymbolizeKeys`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_symbolize_keys.rb) | yes | Detects `hash.transform_keys(&:to_sym)` patterns that should use `symbolize_keys`. |
| [`PreferTurboPageRefreshBroadcasts`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/prefer_turbo_page_refresh_broadcasts.rb) |  | Enforces Turbo page refreshes over targeted stream broadcasts. |
| [`PrivateConstantsInPrivateSection`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/private_constants_in_private_section.rb) |  | A constant that only serves the implementation belongs in the private section, where every other implementation detail already lives. |
| [`PrivateDelegatePlacement`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/private_delegate_placement.rb) | yes | `delegate ... |
| [`PrivateMethodsInPrivateSection`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/private_methods_in_private_section.rb) |  | A method you define goes in the private section, not above it with a `private :name` afterwards. |
| [`PrivateNestedClassMethodVisibility`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/private_nested_class_method_visibility.rb) |  | Detects public methods in private nested classes that are never called from outside. |
| [`PrivateNestedClasses`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/private_nested_classes.rb) |  | Requires nested classes to be declared in the private section. |
| [`PublicMethodsMustHaveTests`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/public_methods_must_have_tests.rb) |  | Ensures all public methods in classes and modules have corresponding tests. |
| [`RedundantConcernExtend`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/redundant_concern_extend.rb) | yes | Detects unnecessary extend ActiveSupport::Concern. |
| [`RedundantConstantNamespace`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/redundant_constant_namespace.rb) | yes | A constant reference does not need to repeat the namespace it is already written inside. |
| [`RepeatedFixtureInTests`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/repeated_fixture_in_tests.rb) |  | Detects when the same fixture is called in multiple tests. |
| [`RestrictedControllerActions`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/restricted_controller_actions.rb) |  | Restricts controller actions to the 7 standard Rails actions. |
| [`RoutesModuleScope`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/routes_module_scope.rb) | yes | Ensures repeated `module:` options in routes are extracted to a scope block. |
| [`SingleLineSetupBlock`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/single_line_setup_block.rb) | yes | Enforces the use of `{ }` instead of `do end` for single-line setup and teardown blocks. |
| [`SingleSingletonClass`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/single_singleton_class.rb) |  | A class declares its class-level methods in a single `class << self` section. |
| [`SingleTopLevelClassOrModule`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/single_top_level_class_or_module.rb) |  | Forbids multiple classes or modules at the top level of a file. |
| [`SingleUseFixtureVariable`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/single_use_fixture_variable.rb) | yes | Detects when a fixture is assigned to a variable but only used once. |
| [`SingleUseSetupVariable`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/single_use_setup_variable.rb) | yes | Detects instance variables assigned in setup blocks that are used in at most one test. |
| [`SingularScopeNames`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/singular_scope_names.rb) |  | Ensures scope names are singular (unless they use `with_*` prefix). |
| [`SystemTestBrowserDriver`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/system_test_browser_driver.rb) |  | Keeps system tests on a real browser driver. |
| [`TestMethodDefinition`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/test_method_definition.rb) |  | Enforces `test "description" do` over `def test_*`, and block syntax for setup and teardown over method definitions. |
| [`TestMethodOrder`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/test_method_order.rb) | yes | Ensures tests are ordered following the method definition order in the source file. |
| [`TooManyInstanceVariables`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/too_many_instance_variables.rb) |  | Flags private methods with too many instance variable assignments. |
| [`TooManyLocalVariables`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/too_many_local_variables.rb) |  | Flags methods with too many local variable assignments. |
| [`TooManyValidationGuards`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/too_many_validation_guards.rb) |  | Counts only validation guards: leading `return`s that reject input by returning nothing, `nil`, or `false`. |
| [`UnnecessaryLocalVariable`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/unnecessary_local_variable.rb) | yes | Detects local variables that alias a method call that already reads as a name. |
| [`UnusedPrivateMethodInNestedClass`](../lib/rubocop/cop/callbacksystems/unused_private_method_in_nested_class.rb) |  | Detects unused private methods in private nested classes. |
